wwo.name: Rio de Janeiro
wwo.method: The Reis cadastral plan supplies drawn streets, working shores, pre-fill beaches, contours and bounded street blocks. Revision 2 retraces the Gamboa to Saúde approach and ordinary blocks, the Glória to Flamengo shore and the Catete connections. Registration is locally adjusted around Saúde. Inferred building massing uses only drawn ordinary-block perimeters. West-sheet alignment and individual buildings remain provisional.

registration.model: Single affine from hand-read source pixels to WGS84. Near-north raster is the 3840 px public-domain derivative cropped to x=590..2280/y=820..1940 and rotated 138 degrees counterclockwise with expansion to 2006 by 1964. Revision 2 adds a bounded smooth shift around the Saúde church mark; all other controls and the base matrix are unchanged.
registration.seam: The joined original sheets have a dark, visually continuous diagonal paper seam in the working rotation. West sheet has one matched palace block center. Rail and street segments crossing the seam follow the visible same alignments on each side. Their near-view absolute accuracy is unverified.

controls.name: Saude summit symbol, approximate historical church match
Quinta da Boa Vista palace courtyard block center
Outeiro da Gloria summit symbol, approximate historical church match
Largo do Machado historical square center

registration.limitations: Controls are plot markers or area centers, with image-center interpretation noted. Church marks are point candidates only. Sao Cristovao parish church, moved entrance gates and ambiguously placed names were excluded. The cross-sheet track and port slopes cannot yet be used for meter-scale alignment. The 124.7 m Saúde leave-one-out value describes the original affine. Local residual at the one translation anchor cannot measure block- or street-level accuracy. The original west-sheet rail position has no independent local residual.

local_adjustments.area: Saúde and nearby Gamboa and Valongo transition
local_adjustments.note: Local one-point translation. Weight is full through 0.33 of the elliptical source-pixel radius, then smoothly fades to zero at a radius of 1.0. No citywide accuracy claim follows from this correction.
local_adjustments.basis: Centroid of the small church mark read at this scan resolution and location in the municipal protected-property catalogue. Nearby municipal monument markers have not been established as independent source-image centers.

sources.date: Manoel Pereira Reis; Rio de Janeiro: Lith. do Archivo Militar, 1900
sources.licence: Historic public-domain map. Credit Library of Congress Geography and Map Division.
sources.precision: Printed on two sheets, viewed in the joined 3840 by 2165 public-domain copy. Solid street traces and mapped physical edges only. Consult control residuals for the limits of hand registration.
